**Methodology disposition (unchanged).** All nine areas have scoped local coverage: diagnosis (`bug-diagnosis.md`), TDD (`tdd.md`), design (`design-principles.md`), review (`reviewer.md`+`review.md`), verification (`verification-principles.md`), research (`research.md`), planning (`planning.md`), delivery (`delivery.md`), retrospective (`retrospective.md`+template). No catalogue migration needed. Three remaining content gaps: (G1) user-path driver + pre-change baseline in `verification-principles.md`; (G2) append-only decision trail for multi-phase runs in `execution-principles.md`; (G3) retrospective escalation ladder + fail-first proof in `reference/retrospective.md`.

**Snapshot integrity.** All eight payload hashes equal `.audit/methodology-79-snapshot-v1/manifest.json` and the working tree (BAD=0). Base `f801ae9…`; `methodologySha` in `tools/isswf-job.mjs:15` stays `37a56bc…` intentionally. `.factory/models.json` and `.agents` methodology bytes outside the eight are untouched.

**Scope confirmed by actual diff/callers.** Only `profileFiles` (`isswf-job.mjs:17`) gained `bug-diagnosis/tdd/design/comments`; `pi-worker-task.mjs` added `nativeWorkerInstructions` and wired it into `getSystemPrompt` (`:181`); `check-quality.mjs` added the new test to its output; three docs/role files reworded transport to native-neutral. No route, role, grant, or model tuple changed; `model-routing.md` only added "routes are independent of transport". Prompt projects `worker.md` from `## Assignment contract` to `## Dispatch configuration`, so it retains Assignment/Execution/Boundaries/Return and grant language, omits the historical coordinator dispatch section, and states the SDK-only `sandbox_shell` contract. The function throws when section markers are absent. The test exercises preamble markers, brief injection, real-worker sentence preservation (`safe reproduction…`, `does not create a TDD requirement`, no implied push/merge/deploy), conditional disclosure ("read only when trigger applies"), `/factory/...` paths, and malformed-input throws.

**Standards verdict: PASS.** Changes are minimal, single-purpose, and consistent with local contracts (authorization in brief, references conditional, instructions ≠ capability). Non-blocking note: the test asserts omission only against the synthetic worker text; the real-worker projection is not asserted to exclude route/dispatch text. Suggested-for-future, not a blocker.

**Spec verdict: PASS.** The accepted objective — own referenced refs available, prompt preserves grant/worker body while omitting coordinator transport, docs transport-neutral, no pin/route/grant expansion — is met. RED (`red-v2.stderr`: `bug-diagnosis.md` missing) → GREEN (`green-v2.json`: seven `pinnedReferencesAvailable`, publicCli/adapter/quality PASS) matches source I inspected. Independent review is warranted and not self-certified.

**Independence.** I authored no candidate source and edited nothing; I only read the frozen snapshot, diff, callers, and tests.

**Future needs beyond bounded worker scope (not defects of this fix).** Only the worker role has a native adapter; other roles still require a separately authorized supported context or human. G1/G2 are additions to already-mounted refs; G3's retrospective reference is not in the native mount, so it needs its own future projection decision. No claim of all-role runtime support is made.
